summary: The long-established history holds up: Overtown, Calle Ocho, Wynwood Walls, the Freedom Tower, Joe's and Versailles. Heat facts match the verified record (Giannis trade, 43-39, the Play-In loss to Charlotte, Christmas at Boston, Nov 18, Jan 28, Cup East Group B). I corrected 15 claims. Among them: the Presidents' Day home team, the Panthers streak, the Telemundo location, the Wade and Jordan Brand framing, the Vice-era years and an expired August tax-window hook. Others were unsupported names and roles: Sanguich founders, Ghee, Haslem broadcasting, Bam's Nike alignment. Live checks confirmed Club Space, Shoe Gallery and the Little Haiti Cultural Complex are open. Still open: small-business status, partner ownership, Giannis's jersey number, the home opener and the unannounced City Edition. The strategy also ignores design lead times and passed windows (Carnival, Hispanic Heritage Month, Oct 15 launch).
